text:
Maya: Quick pantry note — noticed the communal pantry is low on olive oil, tahini, and decaf pods. Also set up the new cold-brew urn in the basement sink area. Please don't move it without @Facilities heads-up.

Elliot: Thanks for the heads up. Can we do a quick poll: weekly restock volunteers? I can take week of Apr 6. :raised_hand:

Sanjay: I'll take alternating Tuesdays. Also putting a sticky on the jar for cost contributions. Who prefers a shared Venmo vs cash jar?

Ava: Venmo works. I'll chip in $10 this morning. Also can we label opened jars with 'OPENER' and date? People leave half-used bottles.

Jordan: Agreed on labels. I printed some Avery labels — putting them next to the printer. Use `OWNER: name | OPENED: 2026-04-01` format.

KitchenBot: Reminder: Please recycle glass bottles. Kitchens policy: Rinse and put in the blue bin by 5pm Fridays.

Elliot: Poll: breakfast for next Friday — bagels, croissants, or fruit bowls? React with :bagel:, :croissant:, :banana:

Maya: Bagels :bagel:

Sanjay: Fruit bowls :banana:

Ava: Croissants :croissant:

Jordan: Also re: cold-brew — if you use the urn, filter grounds go in compost bucket next to dishwasher. Don't dump them in sink.

OrderBot: Scheduled: pantry restock order placed by @Ava for 2026-04-04. Items: olive oil (2L), tahini (500g), decaf pods (1 box). Cost estimate $42.50.

Maya: Huge thanks @Ava! I'll transfer $15 Venmo to you. Can someone volunteer to monitor the sticker ledger each week?

Elliot: I'll check the ledger and add restock notes after my shifts. :thumbsup:

KitchenBot: FYI — we've added a new 'short-use' shelf for opened jars. Please keep one-day items on the front row.
